verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap at prem kai parasapar pooran pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: Significance of meeting of Guru and Guru-oriented men is limitless. Because of deep love in the heart of the Sikh of the Guru, light divine then glows in him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਛਬਿ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharas anoop roop ra(n)g a(n)g a(n)g chhab herat hiraane dhirag bisam bisavaiaas hai ||

en.bdb: Seeing the beauty of the True Guru, His form, colour and image of His every limb, the eyes of a Guru-loving person are astonished. It also generates craving in his mind to see and behold the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਨ ਝੁਨ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਨ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh nidhaan anahadh run jhun dhun sunat surat mat haran abhiaas hai ||

en.bdb: By inexhaustible practicing of meditation on Guru's words, a soft and mellow tune of unstruck music appears in the mystical tenth door. Perpetual hearing of it causes him to remain in a state of trance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੮੪॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat mil paramadhabhut gat pooran bilaas hai ||284||

en.bdb: By focusing his vision in the True Guru and keeping the mind engrossed in the teachings and sermons of the Guru, he acquires a state of perfect and complete bloom. (284)
